title: SentinelOne Retrieval Recipe
description: A single validated, parametrised retrieval recipe (Phase 2, Milestone 4) -- the exact tool call sequence that answers one coverage-matrix row. Every recipe must be validated against the live tenant before being tagged 'stable'.

intent.description: The question_class from the coverage matrix this recipe implements.

inputs.description: Named parameters this recipe accepts from the caller (e.g. time window, hostname, CVE ID).

tool_calls.description: Ordered sequence of MCP tool calls that implement this recipe. Tool names and parameters must match data/knowledge/sentinelone/mcp_tools.md's real, verified schemas -- not invented parameter names.

parameters.description: Parameter template for this call. Values may reference this recipe's inputs by name (e.g. '{{hostname}}') or a prior tool_calls[] step's output (e.g. '{{steps[0].storylineId}}').

purpose.description: Why this call exists in the sequence, e.g. 'resolve storylineId before the DV sweep'.

expected_result_shape.description: What a correct result looks like structurally.

validated_edge_cases.description: Edge cases this recipe has actually been run against on the live tenant, and what happened -- not assumed.

observed_behavior.description: What actually happened when this case was hit, and how it should be classified per the Task Execution Protocol's empty-result rules.

status.description: Only 'stable' recipes run without analyst confirmation. A recipe may only be marked 'stable' after a live-tenant validation run, never from a dry run.

regression_fixture.description: Path to a fixture in tests/fixtures/ that this recipe must pass, if one exists (e.g. tests/fixtures/threat_count_source.md).
